title: UK Space Agency publishes quantum technology roadmap
excerpt: The document outlines strategic priorities for the UK space sector through the 2040 horizon.
bodyHtml:
The UK Space Agency released the Quantum Technology Roadmap for Space on October 27, 2026. This document establishes strategic priorities for the UK space sector for the period spanning 2026 to 2040.

The roadmap focuses on areas where quantum technologies can contribute to UK space capability through the 2035 to 2040 horizon. These specific applications include resilient timing, sensing, and more secure communications.

The agency also identifies quantum computing as a longer-term opportunity for the sector. It states that this area is best pursued through close engagement with wider national programmes.

The published roadmap is 52 pages in length and is available in both PDF and HTML formats. The PDF version of the document is 17.7 MB.
